name: Register a research question
trigger: A new or refined research question
steps: open an 'RQ-n: ...' issue with the research-question label | add it to the Research Plan project with phase = Planning | pin it in the RQ index issue | reference it from the roadmap issue | later method and analysis issues reference this RQ issue
traceability_link: RQ issue becomes the root node cited by every downstream artifact

name: Execute a research task
trigger: A task identified from the plan
steps: create an issue from the activity template | label by activity, assign, set phase and priority on the board | branch from the default branch | commit referencing the issue number | open a PR that says 'Closes #n' | review and merge | issue auto-closes and the board status auto-updates
traceability_link: question -> task issue -> branch -> commits -> PR -> merge, fully cross-referenced

name: Record a decision
trigger: A significant methodological or scope decision
steps: open a 'decision' issue | deliberate in the issue or a Discussion with mark-as-answer | add a DECISION_LOG.md Dn entry in a PR | the PR references the decision issue and every affected artifact | merge and close the issue | a later superseding decision links back
traceability_link: decision issue + Dn entry linked to the artifacts it changed

name: Peer-review an artifact
trigger: A substantive change to analysis, methodology or manuscript
steps: branch | open a PR with the PR-template checklist | CODEOWNERS or named reviewers | line comments and suggested changes | required approvals | Actions checks pass | merge
traceability_link: reviewer, comments, approval and checks all recorded on the PR

name: Release and archive a research version
steps: update CITATION.cff | tag vX.Y | publish a GitHub Release with autogenerated notes and assets | the Zenodo webhook mints a DOI and archives the release | add the DOI to README and CITATION.cff | (optional) confirm ORCID linkage
traceability_link: release tied to a commit and to all PRs since the last tag; external DOI added

name: Reproducibility check
trigger: Every PR and a nightly schedule
steps: Actions matrix workflow re-runs the analysis on a pinned environment | job summary and output artifacts are attached to the run | the PR reproducibility checklist item is ticked | Dependabot PRs keep dependencies current and reviewed
traceability_link: machine-checked reproduction evidence attached to the commit

name: Onboard / hand over the project
trigger: A new collaborator or project handover
steps: assign the repository role | point to /docs charter and CONTRIBUTING | the RQ index, roadmap issue and DECISION_LOG give the full state | for handover, transfer ownership or update team membership; confirm the archival-exit route
traceability_link: project state is reconstructable from documentation without tacit knowledge
